format_variant: SSG Team serialized research v6 / encoder call terminator (raw key + file symbol table)
limitations: No native trace of the same protected artifact exists for these positions.
The native opcode number (140 vs 200) of these positions is not established.
Only calls to functions declared in the same file are recognised; external callees are refused.
Default arguments (RECV_INIT) make the signature unknown, so such callees are refused.
native_opcode_relation: These raw keys are mapped to native 140 in opcode_map.json. The native number stays unresolved; encoder_call_map.json never rewrites opcode_map.json and never claims native semantics.
own_probe_files: none; the encoder call form is not observable in the own PHP 5.2 compile-only corpus
scope: Calls to functions declared in the same encoded file, addressed by an index into header_symbols.
status_policy: Require an independent decode of exactly these encoded records together with an aligned native trace of the same protected artifact before promoting this file to 'confirmed'.
